labException: The user requires CPU/Node only and prohibits browser and game changes.

measurementDefinitions.contact: Terminal joint weight >=0.5, within 0.003 m of region minimum Y.
measurementDefinitions.profile: Eight equal rear-to-front Z slices, inclusive 1e-9 m boundaries, as in the project audit.
measurementDefinitions.toeCurve: Maximum world Z in each of 16 equal X bins in the 0.003 to 0.015 m height band. Local minima compared with nearest local maxima on both sides.
measurementDefinitions.thickness: Full terminal-joint region maximum Y minus minimum Y, sole through wrist/ankle transition. Also retain the v2 interior-ellipse measurement within 10%.
measurementDefinitions.v2Interior: Within an ellipse with X/Z radii 0.023/0.031 m centred on input low-region bounds, excluding Z below centre minus 0.010 m; same fixed centres for before and after.
measurementDefinitions.normals: Area-weighted sum of incident face crosses at vertices on triangles touching moved vertices. Unchanged incident triangles contribute their unchanged areas; normals outside this support remain bit-identical.
measurementDefinitions.clipFloors: All channel key times, all channel interval midpoints, and union-key interval midpoints. Every sampled pose compares minima across all 18674 skinned vertices, including the two unchanged 120-vertex primitives against that same input pose.
